2609.35748.title: Improving Test-Time Scaling with Adaptive Looped Transformers
2609.35748.paper_summary: Looped transformers have demonstrated promising parameter efficiency by reusing layers for latent computation. Prior studies compare looped and non-looped models at matched parameters or per-token FLOPs. However, to the best of our knowledge, whether looping improves test-time scaling as outputs grow longer remains underexplored. Through post-training looped transformers, we study the accuracy-compute slope, measured as the accuracy gain per doubling of test-time decoding FLOPs. We find that existing looped transformers often yield steeper slopes than their non-looped baseline, yet underperform it at matched compute. While fixed-depth looping spends extra iterations on every token, our analysis shows that many tokens do not benefit from extra iterations. We therefore propose TaH2, which enables the model to focus extra iterations on the tokens that benefit from looping. It jointly post-trains the backbone and an iteration decider through lookahead depth supervision, which uses online labels indicating whether further iteration improves the prediction. TaH2 improves both the efficiency and attainable accuracy of test-time scaling. On challenging AIME benchmarks, TaH2 improves the accuracy-compute slope by 53% (2.74 vs. 1.79) over the non-looped baseline, exceeding the baseline's peak accuracy by about 3.4 points at matched test-time compute. As the maximum iteration depth increases, existing looped models largely plateau, while TaH2's gain over the non-looped baseline continues to grow from +2.8 points at depth 2 to +3.9 points at depth 8. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TaH.
2609.35748.paper_summary_zh: 循環Transformer通過重用層來進行潛在計算，展現了有希望的參數效率。先前的研究在匹配參數或每個標記的FLOPs上比較了循環和非循環模型。然而，據我們所知，循環是否能改善測試時間的擴展性，隨著輸出變得更長，仍然未被充分探討。通過後訓練的循環Transformer，我們研究了準確性-計算斜率，這是以測試時間解碼FLOPs翻倍所帶來的準確性增益來衡量的。我們發現，現有的循環Transformer通常比其非循環基準產生更陡的斜率，但在匹配計算時卻表現不佳。雖然固定深度的循環在每個標記上花費了額外的迭代，但我們的分析顯示，許多標記並未從額外的迭代中受益。因此，我們提出了TaH2，這使模型能夠將額外的迭代集中在受益於循環的標記上。它通過前瞻深度監督共同後訓練主幹和迭代決策者，該監督使用在線標籤來指示進一步的迭代是否改善預測。TaH2提高了測試時間擴展的效率和可達準確性。在具有挑戰性的AIME基準上，TaH2在非循環基準上提高了53%的準確性-計算斜率（2.74對1.79），在匹配的測試時間計算下超過基準的峰值準確性約3.4點。隨著最大迭代深度的增加，現有的循環模型大多達到平臺，而TaH2在非循環基準上的增益則從深度2的+2.8點增長到深度8的+3.9點。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/thu-nics/TaH獲得。
